sentences.text:
The petitioner is the first accused in Crime No.231 of 2022 of New Mahe Police Station, Kannur,
alleging commission of offences under Sections 498A and 323 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. When this matter is taken up for consideration today, it is the submission of the learned Public Prosecutor that following registration of the Crime, a notice under Section 41A of Code of Criminal Procedure was issued to the petitioner and the petitioner had appeared before the Investigating Officer and had co-operated with the investigation.
It is submitted that following investigation, a final report has been filed and the matter is now pending as C.C.No.887 of 2022 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Thalassery.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Thalassery
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that, in such circumstances, it is for the petitioner to approach that Court for grant of bail.

It is submitted that the petitioner did not appear on summons from that Court and therefore, non- bailable warrant has been issued to the petitioner.
4. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor and having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the opinion that the petitioner can be given an opportunity to surrender before the jurisdictional court and seek bail from that Court.

Accordingly, this bail application is closed, directing that, if the petitioner surrenders before the jurisdictional court within a period of two weeks from today and files an application for bail, the said bail application shall be considered on merits by the jurisdictional court.
Any coercive steps initiated against the petitioner by the jurisdictional court shall be kept in abeyance, till orders are passed in the bail application to be filed by the petitioner as above.
It is made clear that the benefit of this order will not be available to the petitioner unless the petitioner surrenders before the Court within a period of two weeks from today.

Sd/-
